must_identify.item: The trigger is the BATCH_SIZE change from 500 to 2500 (or the larger batch exceeding the limit)
must_identify.evidence: The live pod spec has BATCH_SIZE=2500, 5x higher than the last-applied config — this value was changed (e.g. via kubectl edit/kubectl set env or a direct patch) without updating memory limits accordingly.

notes: The RCA says the last-applied-configuration annotation shows BATCH_SIZE=500. That is consistent with an imperative `kubectl set env`, which does not update the annotation, but a reviewer may want to confirm it against the truncated deployment YAML.
